patterns: How do I use voice input?
responses: Click the microphone button on the interface, speak clearly into your mic, and I will automatically transcribe your speech, classify your intent, and reply!
Just click the big blue microphone icon, allow microphone permission, and start speaking!

patterns: How is the neural network built?
responses: I am driven by a Multi-Layer Perceptron (DNN) in PyTorch. It uses Bag-of-Words embeddings, Linear layers with ReLU activations, Dropout regularization, and Softmax output to predict intent probabilities.
My deep learning architecture converts text into feature vectors and processes them through a trained PyTorch Neural Network to classify intent tags with high confidence.

responses: This project is built using Python 3, PyTorch for Deep Learning, FastAPI for asynchronous web backend, Web Speech API for voice recognition, and modern Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/JS for glassmorphic UI.
